# Aixuno

Aixuno is a free, browser-based AI content conversion platform. It helps users turn AI-generated Markdown content into professional documents and knowledge-base formats without uploading files to a server.

## Main tools

- Markdown to Word: /tools/markdown-to-word.html
- Markdown to PDF: /tools/markdown-to-pdf.html
- Excel to Markdown: /tools/excel-to-markdown.html
- WeChat Markdown formatter: /tools/wechat-format.html

## English tools

- Markdown to Word: /en/tools/markdown-to-word.html
- Markdown to PDF: /en/tools/markdown-to-pdf.html
- Excel to Markdown: /en/tools/excel-to-markdown.html

## English guides

- Convert DeepSeek answers to Word: /en/guides/deepseek-to-word.html
- Export ChatGPT answers to Word: /en/guides/chatgpt-to-word.html
- Choose Word, PDF, or Markdown for an AI answer: /en/guides/how-to-export-ai-answer.html

## Supported AI content sources

DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Doubao, Tongyi Qianwen, and Kimi.

## Chinese guides

- Convert an MD file to Word: /guides/md-file-to-word.html
- Format AI content for WeChat Official Accounts: /guides/ai-content-to-wechat.html

## Purpose

Convert AI-generated content into Word documents, PDF documents, Markdown knowledge-base content, and WeChat-ready rich text. Processing happens locally in the user's browser.
